Repos.title: The Laboratory
Repos.subtitle: Everything we build is public. Come in, copy it, break it and improve it — no permission needed.

descriptions.alquimia: The community site. The very page you are looking at, open from end to end.
descriptions.alquimia-cli: The community in your terminal: one command and the socials, links and news are at hand.

descriptions.videos: The Alquimia promo video, made 100% in code with Remotion and the brand palette.
descriptions.discussions: The community's open forum: questions, ideas and experiments in progress.
